Corrected finding: Supabase org plan is Pro (8,192MB included storage, not the previously-assumed 4,500MB) — kept 4,500MB as the working internal safety margin anyway. Workstream 2 — National source discovery for QLD/SA/WA/TAS/ACT/NT complete (live-verified via WebSearch + gstack /browse + CKAN API/curl, not search-snippet-only). Key finding: free bulk automatable SALES data does not exist in any of the 6 states — all paid or blocked. RENT is available free for QLD (RTA, verified, current to Jun 2026), SA (SA Housing Trust, verified via CKAN API, history to 2008), and WA (DMIRS raw bond lodgements, CC BY 4.0, needs in-house median computation — flagged as extra adapter work). TAS got search-only verification (flagged for follow-up). ACT and NT both live-searched directly against their official portals and confirmed zero results — national-context-only for both this sprint.

Workstream 3 — jurisdiction_coverage.yml + JURISDICTION_COVERAGE_CONTRACT.md complete, built directly from Workstream 2's findings. Documents per-jurisdiction x per-metric-family status for all 8 states/territories. Key finding: supply/demographic context already available nationally for all 8 (confirmed, not assumed); land_values/vacancy/planning_pipeline unavailable nationally (no source found for ANY jurisdiction including NSW/VIC, an honest gap); population_growth capped at partially_available everywhere pending Workstream 4.
